data.title: Marco Rubio: U.S.-Iran Diplomatic Talks Have “Never Really Stopped”
data.description: According to Jin10, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Saturday that diplomatic talks between the United States and Iran had “never really stopped.” He said U.S. President Donald Trump’s preferred approach to addressing challenges around the world was to resolve them through diplomatic and peaceful means whenever possible. Iran’s top diplomat said Saturday that Iran currently has no plans to hold talks with the United States, despite growing concern that fighting between the two sides could resume.

data.title: Binance News Update | Binance Publishes New Proof of Reserves Snapshot, Full Zero-Knowledge Proof Due Tuesday as Withdrawals Stay on Track for Sunday
data.description: Binance has taken a new Proof of Reserves snapshot and published it on its Proof of Reserves website, the exchange said on Saturday, October 31. The snapshot, taken at 00:00 UTC on October 31, gives an updated view of assets that are fully accounted for following its recent security incident. A full zero-knowledge proof, which will let users independently verify their balances, is expected by Tuesday, November 3 (UTC).Users Can Verify 1:1 BackingThe full zero-knowledge proof takes about 40 to 50 hours to generate because of the computing power involved, Binance said. Once it is ready, users holding any of the ten tokens Binance has fully backed, BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC, will be able to confirm independently that their assets are backed at least 1:1.A zero-knowledge proof lets an exchange show that its reserves cover all user balances without revealing any individual account details. Binance had earlier targeted Proof of Reserves results by Monday, November 2; the snapshot is now live, with the full proof following on Tuesday.Commitment to Cover All LossesBinance repeated that it will fully cover the financial impact of the funds stolen in the incident. “We will continue to demonstrate this commitment through measurable progress, transparent reporting, and concrete actions,” the exchange said. It has already replenished 90% of the stolen assets and is buying the remaining, less liquid tokens through market and over-the-counter channels.Withdrawals on Track for SundayReopening withdrawals is Binance’s next milestone. The exchange said it remains on track to resume withdrawals within its previously stated timeframe, on Sunday, November 1, and will share details once they are confirmed.

data.title: Hackers Hijack 12 DeFi Websites Registered With Name.com, Stealing About $138,000
data.description: Hackers hijacked 12 DeFi websites registered with Name.com late Friday, using Step Drainer malware to trick visitors into approving wallet transfers; 10 domains were suspended at the registrar level on Saturday, while Flap and Kintsu remained operational. The Block traced about $138,000 in stolen funds onchain, according to The Block, though losses on Solana and Aptos may not be included and the number of victims remains unclear. Kintsu and Origami Finance blamed Vercel, while Name.com and Vercel had not publicly explained the incident.

data.title: Yi He: Binance Has Allocated $6.34 Billion to Cover Users, Ten Major Tokens Are 100% Backed, and Full Proof Is Due Tuesday
data.description: Binance co-CEO Yi He said on Saturday, October 31, that the exchange has set aside $6.34 billion of its own corporate funds to cover users affected by its security incident, and that ten major tokens are now fully backed: BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC. Binance will keep buying the remaining altcoins through market and over-the-counter channels until every token reaches 100% backing.Binance completed a new Proof of Reserves snapshot at 00:00 UTC on October 31, now available on its Proof of Reserves website. Because the full zero-knowledge proof needs substantial computing power, it will take about 40 to 50 hours to generate and is expected on Tuesday, November 3 (UTC). Once it is published, holders of any of the ten tokens will be able to verify independently that their assets are backed at least 1:1.

data.title: Richard Teng: Binance Has Replenished 90% of Stolen Assets and Users Will Not Bear the Financial Impact
data.description: Binance co-CEO Richard Teng said on Saturday, October 31, that the exchange has replenished 90% of the assets stolen in its security incident and is committed to covering the remaining 10%. “Our users will not bear the financial impact of this incident,” Teng wrote on X. He said Binance has shared an updated Proof of Reserves snapshot and is working toward resuming withdrawals on November 1. “We know how important trust is, especially in moments like this,” he said, adding that Binance will keep users updated every step of the way.

data.title: DeepSeek Publishes New Super-Agent Architecture
data.description:
The DeepSeek Harness team published a technical article on the evening of October 31 titled “Exploring Super-Agent Design: Toward More Autonomous Agent Systems.” According to Odaily, DeepSeek said the rise of personal agents has exposed limits in existing agent designs, which typically treat each session as an independent unit and struggle to support large-scale multitasking and team collaboration.

The proposed architecture combines a two-layer structure, event-driven processes, asynchronous multi-channel interaction, separation of storage and computing, and an external watchdog. DeepSeek said the system handles session management and context synchronization, allowing people to focus on decisions and review. The team said an internal Super-agent built on the approach is running and is used for reproducing and fixing issues, responding to code reviews, and iterating on DeepSeek Harness.

data.title: Binance News Update | Binance Replenishes 90% of Stolen Assets and Fully Backs BTC, ETH, USDT and Seven Other Tokens, With Withdrawals on Track for Sunday
data.description: Binance has replenished 90% of the assets stolen in its recent security incident, up from about 80% a day earlier, the exchange said in its third recovery update on Saturday, October 31. Ten major tokens are now fully backed: BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC. Binance said it will keep buying the remaining tokens until every affected asset is 100% covered.“Binance will absorb the financial impact of these stolen funds, not our users,” the exchange said.How the Losses Were CoveredBinance said the replenishment drew on three sources:SAFU fund: a partial deployment of its Secure Asset Fund for Users, expected over the next 24 hours. Users can track the fund’s balance on-chain.Futures insurance fund: a portion of the fund, with the remaining balance kept as a regulatory requirement.Corporate treasury: Binance’s own company funds.The remaining 10% is made up of tokens outside the ten fully backed assets. Because these are less liquid, Binance said they may take longer to buy in the required amounts, and it is working with industry partners to complete the purchases through market and OTC channels.New Proof of Reserves SnapshotBinance took a new Proof of Reserves snapshot at 00:00 UTC on October 31, and it is already available on the exchange’s Proof of Reserves website. The full zero-knowledge proof takes about 40 to 50 hours to generate and is expected by Tuesday, November 3 (UTC). Once it is ready, users holding any of the ten fully backed tokens will be able to independently verify that their assets are backed at least 1:1.Withdrawals on Track for SundayBinance said its next milestone is reopening withdrawals, which remain on track for Sunday, November 1, within its previously stated timeframe. The exchange will confirm details in a further update. It said it will continue to show its commitment through “measurable progress, transparent reporting, and concrete actions.”

data.title: Iran’s Supreme Leader Orders Military to Expand Retaliation Options Without Geographic Limits
data.description:
Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba has ordered senior military commanders to prepare for renewed confrontation with the United States and Israel and expand Tehran’s retaliation options. According to Sina Finance, a statement released Saturday said Mojtaba told the commanders of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, the army, and the armed forces’ general staff that “every level and type of threat must be met immediately and effectively, without geographic limits.” He ordered the military to update its list of potential targets to include “all tangible and intangible assets” of the United States and Israel within the armed forces’ strike range.

Mojtaba also said he would maintain “intelligent combat readiness” for a forceful confrontation with the enemy, describing it as a prerequisite for achieving maximum deterrence, and urged the military to use new technology to enhance its capabilities. The statement did not say when or where the meeting took place. As far as is known, this was the first time he had convened the senior military commanders as head of state. He has not appeared publicly since the United States and Israel launched the war in February, and only a few Iranian officials have said they have spoken with him.

The remarks underscored Iran’s heightened state of alert and its determination to respond more forcefully. Iran is preparing for possible renewed U.S. and Israeli strikes as diplomatic efforts to end the conflict resume. The United States has warned Gulf countries to prepare for another strike on Iran after the November 3 midterm elections. On Thursday, U.S. Central Command briefed U.S. President Donald Trump on possible military options.

Mojtaba said: “If the enemy resumes military or terrorist attacks, the Iranian armed forces and the Iranian people will decide when and under what conditions they end.”
